#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    std::vector<int> kpos, vpos, opos;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (s[i] == 'V') {
            vpos.push_back(i);
        } else if (s[i] == 'K') {
            kpos.push_back(i);
        } else {
            opos.push_back(i);
        }
    }

    int nk = kpos.size();
    int nv = vpos.size();
    int no = opos.size();

    const int INF = 1000000000;
    // 4D DP array: dimensions [2][nk+1][nv+1][no+1]
    int dp[2][101][101][101];
    for (int h = 0; h < 2; ++h)
        for (int k = 0; k <= nk; ++k)
            for (int v = 0; v <= nv; ++v)
                for (int o = 0; o <= no; ++o)
                    dp[h][k][v][o] = INF;

    dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int k = 0; k <= nk; ++k) {
        for (int v = 0; v <= nv; ++v) {
            for (int o = 0; o <= no; ++o) {
                for (int h = 0; h < 2; ++h) {
                    int val = dp[h][k][v][o];
                    if (val == INF) continue;
                    // Place 'K'
                    if (k < nk && h == 0) {
                        int cost = val + std::max(kpos[k] - v, 0) + std::max(kpos[k] - o, 0);
                        if (cost < dp[0][k + 1][v][o]) {
                            dp[0][k + 1][v][o] = cost;
                        }
                    }
                    // Place 'V'
                    if (v < nv) {
                        int cost = val + std::max(vpos[v] - k, 0) + std::max(vpos[v] - o, 0);
                        if (cost < dp[1][k][v + 1][o]) {
                            dp[1][k][v + 1][o] = cost;
                        }
                    }
                    // Place other character
                    if (o < no) {
                        int cost = val + std::max(opos[o] - v, 0) + std::max(opos[o] - k, 0);
                        if (cost < dp[0][k][v][o + 1]) {
                            dp[0][k][v][o + 1] = cost;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int answer = std::min(dp[0][nk][nv][no], dp[1][nk][nv][no]);
    std::cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
